title: Dolly Parton’s Business Maxims: How She Built & Ran Her Empire, in Her Own Words
summary: Dolly Parton was much more than music — her business spanned theme parks, movies, product lines and more. How did she manage it all?
body: The outpouring of grief following Dolly Parton ’s death last week at the age of 80 was universal and apt: The country icon was beloved as few are these days, both for her music and her general Dolly-ness. But just as much attention was paid to her philanthropic work and business acumen, both of which were legendary in their own right. For Parton, her business sense goes back to the very beginning of her career, when she made the decision alongside her uncles in the 1960s to launch her own publishing company — a choice that, more than 3,000 songs later, is still paying off. (“As I’ve always said, my songs are my children and I expect them to support me when I’m old,” Parton said in 2017 .) Over time, that business empire blossomed into one encompassing not just publishing but record companies, brand deals, TV and film productions, books, product lines — and, of course, theme parks, with the Dollywood park in Tennessee one of her most indelible endeavors. title: Google Clock’s new timer UI is here, and your muscle memory won’t like it
summary: Google Clock's Timers tab just got a big makeover.
body: Credit: Andy Walker / Android Authority TL;DR Google is gradually rolling out a new UI for timers in the Clock app. The numbers are flatter and come without the circular background; there are presets for 1, 5, 10, and 15 minutes; and the start button has moved. Multiple timers now appear as a grid. Google has rolled out a few updates as part of the September Android Drop, like Guided Vision for Gemini Live and a crossover between Google Messages and Keep . Not to be missed, the company is also giving the Google Clock app some attention. Specifically, the Timers tab is going to look a little different from how you remember. In the UI you’re familiar with, the Timers tab features a large card with rounded numbers. The numbers are also rounded for the numeric keypad overlay, but these numbers are contained in a circular background. If you have more than one timer, this card gains an extra button at the bottom to close it so you can see your other timers. When there are multiple timers, they are arranged in a vertical pattern, allowing you to scroll through them.

title: Gemini and Find Hub are teaming up to remember where you put your passport
summary: Or your spare key, or your birth certificate, or whatever else.
body: TL;DR As part of the September Android Drop, Find Hub and Gemini are adding a new option to remember the locations of items that can’t be digitally tracked. You’ll be able to save and recall item locations by voice using Gemini, with an option to add a photo illustrating where you left your item. These options are coming soon to phones running Android 16 or newer. Google’s Find Hub lets you find various types of connected devices, from smartphones to earbuds to dedicated item trackers, all from a single interface. Starting this month, you’ll also be able to use Find Hub to remember the location of non-connected devices. As part of the September Android Drop announced today , Find Hub is rolling out an option that’ll let users make a note of any object’s location. body: NASA/Clayton Rougelot On Aug. 24, technicians at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida began installing the four RS‑25 engines in the core stage of the agency’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket that will carry the Artemis III crew into low Earth orbit in 2027. Each RS‑25 engine has a unique serial number that records its detailed flight history. The four engines assigned to Artemis III — E2054, E2057, E2048, and E2052 — previously powered multiple space shuttle missions. Engine 2048 helped launch NASA astronaut Randy Bresnik’s earlier mission aboard space shuttle Atlantis during STS‑129. It also flew on Space Shuttle Discovery during STS‑95 in 1998, the mission that returned 77-year‑old space pioneer U.S. Sen. John Glenn to orbit, making him the oldest person to fly in space at that time.

title: Your Pixel 11 will soon have a fix for the static noise ruining your videos
summary: Google confirms Pixel 11 video static noise bug, promises a fix is coming.
body: Credit: Shimul Sood / Android Authority TL;DR Pixel 11 series users have been reporting an issue with Video Boost. The issue causes static noise to appear in videos recorded with the feature. A Google spokesperson has confirmed to Android Authority that a fix has been identified and a rollout will come in the following weeks. The Pixel 11 series just recently launched, and it’s stumbling out of the gate with a video recording problem. If you’ve noticed noisy static in your recordings, you’re not alone. As Android Authority reported last week, a number of buyers have been experiencing this problem. Fortunately, it may not be long before a fix arrives. To quickly summarize the situation, we spotted reports on Reddit that suggested there was an issue with Video Boost (a Pixel camera feature that enhances video color, lighting, stabilization, and low-light detail). According to the reports, videos captured with this feature on contained static noise. The cause of the issue is unknown, but some attributed it to an Audio Zoom (a feature that boosts the sound of the zoomed-in subject while cutting down background noise) bug.

summary: تصل قيمة الصفقة إلى 30 مليون جنيه إسترليني
body: تصل قيمة الصفقة إلى 30 مليون جنيه إسترليني أعلن نادي ليفربول، يوم الثلاثاء، عن صفقة جديدة قبل ساعات من إغلاق الميركاتو الصيفي. وأصدر ليفربول، بيانا رسميا، أكد فيه توصله إلى اتفاق لضم حارس المرمى لوكا بروجمانز، من نادي جينك البلجيكي. جينك. ووقع اللاعب البالغ من العمر 18 عاماً، عقداً طويل الأمد مع فريق ليفربول في مركز تدريب أكسا. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة" سيعود الآن إلى جينك وسيبقى مع الفريق البلجيكي الذي يلعب في دوري الدرجة الأولى طوال موسم 2026-2027. بعد 32 مباراة مع فريق جينك الثاني، انضم بروجمانز إلى الفريق الأول ليخوض أول مباراة له في أبريل 2026. حافظ الحارس على مركزه لبقية الموسم، وشارك في 10 مباريات أخرى في الدوري البلجيكي. استمر بروجمانز في حراسة مرمى جينك في بداية الموسم الجديد أيضاً، حيث شارك في جميع المباريات الأربع حتى الآن. بعد أن قاد منتخب بلجيكا في كل من بطولة أوروبا تحت 17 سنة وكأس العالم تحت 17 سنة في عام 2025، أصبح الآن قائداً لمنتخب بلاده تحت 19 سنة. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات "كووورة" ووفقا لهيئة الإذاعة البريطانية " بي بي سي "، تصل قيمة الصفقة إلى 30 مليون جنيه إسترليني شاملة الإضافات، وسيبقى في جينك على سبيل الإعارة هذا الموسم قبل الانتقال إلى أنفيلد قبل انطلاق موسم 2027-2028.   We have agreed…

Google’s switch from Samsung Exynos to a MediaTek modem on the Pixel 11 series was supposed to close one of the longest-running chapters in Pixel history. After years of complaints around reception, connectivity, and cellular battery drain, the new modem arrived as one of the generation’s most meaningful upgrades. Users can toggle logging between Limited (up to three days/100MB) and Detailed (up to 12 hours/100MB) tiers, download logs, or delete them. Google rolled out Android 17 QPR2 Beta 4 , and alongside several under-the-hood tweaks, it introduces a major transparency upgrade for how the OS handles sensitive on-device data. The new release adds a dedicated “Data logging” section for the Private Compute Core right inside Privacy Dashboard. Private Compute Core is Android’s isolated sandbox that powers machine learning features such as Live Caption, Now Playing, and Smart Reply, without exposing user data directly to the cloud or other apps. While Private Compute Core has historically operated in a secure silo, this new Privacy Dashboard entry in Android 17 QPR2 Beta 4 lets users actively monitor, log, and review any outbound data leaving the Private Compute Core environment.

title: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude quietly get worse over time. This hidden setting fixes them
summary: Your favorite AI chatbot might be remembering a little too much.
body: I’ve been using LLM-based AI in some capacity for roughly half a decade, and in that time, the industry has changed significantly. Not only have newer competitors like Gemini and Claude arrived on the scene, but older tools like ChatGPT have also evolved dramatically. We’ve seen better third-party app integration, increased reasoning capabilities, and countless other advancements. However, I would argue that the ability to retain memories matters most. Retaining context from previous conversations helps the AI better anticipate your needs within a single session. It also allows the tool to learn more about you, ensuring that future conversations are tailored to your preferences. However, there is a real downside to memory accumulation that not everyone considers. I’ve found that starting with a new AI usually requires significant input to generate the responses I need and fully understand my user profile. Once it reaches this data “sweet spot,” the AI becomes much more pleasant to use. Yet, slowly over time, the experience often seems to degrade again.
